verdict.rationale: Embedded white-label payroll through a partner API is a fair question for a payroll/PEO provider, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only Justworks' own end-user payroll, PTO, onboarding and Xero accounting-sync workflows, with no mention of a partner or embedded API. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec. The Xero integration is an adjacent outbound sync, not an embeddable payroll API, so it earns no credit.
